properties.name: brooklyn_1836
properties.map: Topographical Map of the City and County of New-York, and the adjacent Country — J. H. Colton & Co., New York 1836 (engr. S. Stiles & Co.)
properties.georeferencing: as manhattan_1836, refined over Brooklyn and Williamsburgh with 19 windows matched to today's streets (tools/gcps_own.json, colton1836_bk), thin-plate spline
properties.note: The City of Brooklyn (chartered 1834) as Colton shades it: the parts of blocks built on, from the Heights and the ferry to about Bridge / Gold St and south to about Atlantic St, with outlying built pieces towards Fort Greene and South Brooklyn. The Navy Yard (drawn with buildings but not shaded as blocks) is left out. Colton's map shows Brooklyn only as far as the sheet reaches (about Bergen St in the south, Clinton Av in the east).
properties.method: built blocks classified by tone on the warped map (tools/classify.py, parameters in tools/classify_runs.py), clipped to a hand-drawn envelope
